text: The sample standard deviation (sigma) of 30.9039 degrees for the roll measurement indicates how much the roll values from your IMU module vary from the average roll value. A larger standard deviation means that the roll measurements are spread out widely, suggesting there may be significant fluctuations in your readings. This could be due to factors like noise in the sensor data or instability in the setup. To improve the reliability of your measurements, you might want to look into reducing any sources of error or noise, which could help lower this standard deviation and give you more consistent results.
